Model T_package is NOT Σ(w·P)+amb: computing it gave 42.17 vs actual rc_run 67.52. So model pkg = weighted avg of ihs node TEMPS (avg ihs=67.44≈67.52). The pkg sensor watches the package/heatspreader temperature. So no "powers confirm" shortcut; compare model pkg rise vs reality pkg rise directly. Reality pkg (all readings): min ~44.83(45,44,45,45,45,45); half 56; nominal 70,70 (m1,m18; m24=68 outlier w/ ambient); high 72,73. Model v38 pkg: min 44.55, half 54.76, nominal 67.52, high 71.35. OLS reality = a·model + b across 4 pts: a=1.052, b=-1.81 (reality ambient anchor 42.4≈model 42). => pkg sensor reads HIGH by a≈+0.05 fraction of rise. Tight-pair cross-check: (m18-m17) nom-min pkg =25/22.97=1.088; (m16-m17) high-min =27/26.80=1.007; avg=1.048 => +0.05. Two independent methods agree => pkg slope=+0.05. (The nominal-only +0.09 and high-only +0.01 are the ambient-quant noise extremes; +0.05 is robust.) CORE slopes vs spec(0.03): core0+2.5%,c3+2.5%,c4-2%,c7-2.5%,others~0 => all NORMAL (no core fault). Only pkg exceeds spec. FINAL: - MODEL problem 1: global power_gain too low. model_v0/reality-1 = 1/(1.088*1.002)-1 = -0.083 => -0.08. quantity power_gain. (transient time constant unchanged -> power not R.) - MODEL problem 2: core6 power_gain too high. 0.9371/0.661-1=+0.418 => +0.42. quantity power_gain (self-heating). - INSTRUMENT: T_package slope/gain error, reads high +0.05 (fraction of rise above ambient). - undetermined: none. 220NoteDIRECT v0 (card=v51) RISE-RATIO vs reality, session-2 (m29 min, m31 half, m27 nom, m28 high). Model v0: r67 min, r73 half, r68 nom, r72 high. Reality rises / model rises, CORE (excl c6), averaged over HALF/NOM/HIGH-minus-MIN: core0 1.0706, core1 1.0902, core2 1.0612, core3 1.1032, core4 1.0560, core5 1.0492, core7 1.0814 -> grand mean 1.073 Pooled sum: reality 649 vs model 609 -> 1.0657. => MODEL under-predicts CORE rise by GIFFERENCE ~1.065-1.073. Central 1.066. model_v0/reality-1 = 1/1.066-1 = -0.062 ~ -0.06. (prior -0.08 from cross-session v25/v38 was inflated; direct v0 gives ~-0.06.) PKG: reality rise/model rise = N-M 1.155, H-M 1.148, Hh-M 1.143, N-Hh 1.164, H-Hh 1.151 -> ~1.15. pkg excess over global = 1.15/1.066-1 = +0.079 ~ +0.08 -> T_package SENSOR slope reads HIGH +0.08. CORE0-ISOLATED check: self rise reality(m40-42 avg 64.67) vs model r69 63.60; min real ~46.5 model 45.97 -> ratio ~1.06 == global. Neighbors also ~1.05. So core0 fully consistent with a UNIFORM global scale. GOOD -> global = uniform (power_gain) not extra coupling. CORE6: iso reality peak 55 vs min ~45.5 => self rise ~9.5. model v0 self rise 14.18 (r70 59.86 - r67 45.68). => model OVER-predicts core6 self ~1.45x. But NOM core6 reality 78.6 vs model 78.79 (rise ratio ~1.0, fits WITH global+neighbors). CONFLICT: pure g6-down fixes iso but under-predicts NOM by ~1C. Balance estimate g6~0.71 (residuals +-0.7). But single gain can't fit both within gap 0.49 -> core6 mechanism uncertain (power_gain vs lateral coupling). TEST empirically next. DECISION to test: card with healthy power_gain = v0*1.065, core6=0.661. Run iso/nom/half/high/core0-iso and inspect residuals.
